why: I checked the verifier brief against both must_not items. It has exactly two checks, "Check 1" and "Check 2", one for each expect line. Its npm test and cmp items sit under "Advisory (not part of PASS/FAIL)", so they get no verdict. That makes them report-only notes, not a third check, though a stricter grader could read them as one. Check 1's PASS and FAIL are about the JSON array from --tsv matching the plain command's output. Check 2's PASS and FAIL are about README.md mentioning --tsv and saying what it does. Neither condition needs npm test or the CSV tests to pass. The builder brief does ask the builder to run npm test and add a test. That's fine, because must_not only limits verifier checks and the line 1 and 2 conditions. Neither forbidden item appears.
